title: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sents.t: Celia Santos had posted the following video on Facebook and states that something terrifying had occurred at a mall in Brazil.
sents.zh: Celia Santos 在 Facebook 上发布了下面这段视频，说巴西的一家商场里发生了可怕的事。

sents.t: The video was taken at 2:30 in the morning by a security guard who works there.
sents.zh: 视频是在凌晨 2 点半由那里的一名保安拍的。

sents.t: He was sure that he was the only person inside, until he saw the following.
sents.zh: 他确信商场里只有他一个人，直到他看到了下面的画面。

sents.t: The security guard had recorded this in the hopes that people would believe him when telling them about this terrifying encounter.
sents.zh: 保安把它录了下来，希望他跟别人讲这次可怕的遭遇时，大家会相信他。

sents.t: There appears to be a little girl on the escalator, who then disappears moments later.
sents.zh: 扶梯上好像有一个小女孩，片刻之后就消失了。

sents.t: Now, this could have been an actual child, but what's a child doing inside a mall at 2 in the morning?
sents.zh: 当然，这可能真是个孩子，但凌晨两点，一个孩子在商场里干什么？

sents.t: I can't think of anything to explain this, other than this being a child who was accidentally locked inside.
sents.zh: 除了是一个不小心被锁在里面的孩子，我想不出别的解释。

sents.t: Now, what's even more strange about this is that the escalator was powered off during the time of this recording.
sents.zh: 更奇怪的是，拍摄时扶梯是断电停运的。

sents.t: Knowing this, it doesn't make sense that the child was able to travel up smoothly without taking a single step.
sents.zh: 知道这一点后，孩子一步都没走，却能平稳地往上移动，这就说不通了。

sents.t: All in all, this one's pretty creepy.
